name: pr-review
author: arbitron
description: Multi-persona PR review pipeline. Clones the PR into an isolated per-instance workspace (never a local ~/Repos checkout), runs Architect R1 -> 10x R1 -> Architect R2 -> 10x R2 -> Security, verifies every required persona actually posted (fail-loud on dropout), then Manager decides. Optionally a senior engineer auto-implements the selected fix tier; verify-fix runs build/tests + a wired-and-fed provenance check and writes a verdict file that record-verdict lifts into the gate. EITHER way the committed fixes are pushed to the PR branch (the per-instance workspace is GC'd after the run, so never pushing = lost work); the gate only decides whether the PR comment reads 'verified clean' or 'pushed but flagged for review'. Reviewers run a mandatory wired-and-fed provenance trace, not just a diff read.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format (e.g. dbinky/arbitron). Cloned fresh (shallow) from the remote into an isolated per-instance workspace; no local ~/Repos checkout is used.

inputs.name: fix_scope
inputs.description: Auto-implement tier. One of: must, must-should, all-but-defer, none. 'none' skips the senior-engineer node entirely.

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Power Automate / Teams webhook URL for the completion alert. Runtime default holds the secret; committed samples leave it empty (the notify-teams step is a no-op when unset, or reads ARBITRON_TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL from the server env).

nodes.label: Init PR workspace
nodes.description: Shallow-clone {{repo}} from the remote into {{workspace}}/work and check out PR #{{pr_number}}; emit {work_dir, pr_branch, pr_head, base}. No ~/Repos is used.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift init-pr-workspace outputs (work_dir, pr_branch, pr_head, base) to top-level vars for the persona templates and commit-push.

nodes.label: Architect R1
nodes.description: Ivory Tower Architect first pass; posts inline + general comments; traces provenance/wiring of new structural pieces

nodes.label: 10x R1
nodes.description: 10x GSD Engineer first pass; runs the wired-and-fed provenance trace, replies to architect threads, adds practical findings

nodes.label: Architect R2
nodes.description: Architect second pass; concedes or doubles down in existing threads only

nodes.label: 10x R2
nodes.description: 10x second pass; final positions in existing threads

nodes.label: Security
nodes.description: Security expert; weighs in on existing debates and posts severity-tagged findings

nodes.label: Verify personas posted
nodes.description: Deterministic fail-loud gate: count comments per required persona prefix (architect/10x/security); abort the run if any posted nothing, so the manager never synthesizes a partial panel.

nodes.label: Manager
nodes.description: Engineering manager; per-thread decisions + Decision Summary with verdict

nodes.label: Senior Engineer
nodes.description: Implements the selected fix tier in the isolated worktree and commits (wired-and-fed, no self-certified half-fixes); the verify-fix gate decides the comment, but the fixes are pushed either way

nodes.label: Verify fix (wired-and-fed gate)
nodes.description: Runs build/tests + a wired-and-fed provenance check on the senior engineer's unpushed commits and WRITES its verdict to {{workspace}}/verify-verdict.json. agent_call does not enforce outputSchema, so the verdict flows via that file (lifted by record-verdict), not via prose.

nodes.label: Record verify verdict
nodes.description: Lift the verify-fix verdict from {{workspace}}/verify-verdict.json into structured outputs {push_ok, blockers} so the fix-gate keys off a reliably-parsed value (agent_call does NOT enforce outputSchema). Defaults push_ok=false (concerns path) if the file is missing — and both fix paths push, so no committed work is ever lost.

nodes.label: Verified clean?
nodes.description: Both outputs push the senior engineer's commits to the PR branch (work is never lost). This gate only decides the PR comment: 'push' => verified-clean comment, 'block' => pushed-but-flagged comment listing the verify-fix blockers.

nodes.label: Push (verified clean)
nodes.description: Commit any uncommitted senior-engineer fixes, push to the PR branch, and post a 'verified clean' comment. Reached when verify-fix passed.

nodes.label: Push + flag (concerns)
nodes.description: Reached when verify-fix flagged concerns: STILL commit + push the fixes (workspace is GC'd, so not pushing = lost work), then post a comment with the blockers asking for human review before merge.

nodes.label: Skipped (review-only)
nodes.description: No-op terminal node reached when fix_scope == 'none'

args: Multi-persona review finished and the senior-engineer {{fix_scope}} fixes were pushed to the PR branch. See the PR for the manager Decision Summary and the verify-fix verdict.

nodes.label: Notify Teams
nodes.description: Post a rich completion alert to the Teams webhook (no-op if teams_webhook_url unset). Reached from BOTH push paths, so every finished review pings Teams regardless of the verdict.
